# Existing Bootstrap Icons runtime

The CSS and WOFF/WOFF2 files are the existing, unmodified **Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3** distribution, under the MIT license in `LICENSE`. They matched the exact pinned distribution byte-for-byte. No icon or shell design change and no version upgrade is included.
